components.purpose: Page heading/intro at the top (e.g. 'Pricing' heading with a short subheading) to introduce the pricing page before the plans.

The core of the request — renders the three plans side by side as cards (via its nested PricingTier items), each with a Name, Price (PriceMonthly/Currency/CurrencySymbol), Highlights, and a CTA 'sign-up' button link.

Optional follow-up section below the cards to address common pricing/billing questions and reduce sign-up friction (not explicitly requested, but commonly paired with pricing cards — can be omitted if the marketer wants a minimal page).
